declaration.preface:
Bhabani Colors Pvt. Ltd. is committed to creating and maintaining a workplace that respects and promotes human rights and fair labor practices. The Company prioritizes safe, healthy, and supportive working conditions for all employees, ensuring that ethical standards are embedded across all operations.

The Company is dedicated to providing equal opportunities for all employees, promoting diversity and inclusion, and ensuring fair and consistent treatment irrespective of background or status. This commitment is reinforced through continuous engagement, structured training, and open communication mechanisms, ensuring that human rights principles are actively integrated into organizational culture and long-term business practices.
declaration.declaration: The Company affirms its responsibility to operate with integrity and social accountability by embedding ethical labor practices and human rights principles into all business activities. It is committed to maintaining safe and dignified working environments, ensuring fairness in employment practices, preventing all forms of exploitation and abuse, and promoting an inclusive and respectful organizational culture. This policy establishes a clear framework for responsible conduct, accountability, and continuous strengthening of labor and human rights standards across the organization and its stakeholder relationships.
declaration.scope: This policy applies to all employees, contractors, suppliers, business partners, and service providers of Bhabani Colors Pvt. Ltd. It covers employment practices, working conditions, occupational health and safety, employee development, and workforce well-being. All covered parties are required to comply with applicable labor laws and human rights standards in line with the Company’s commitment to ethical and responsible business conduct.

focusAreas: Child Labor, Forced Labor & Human Trafficking

Employee Health & Safety: To enhance safety protocols regularly to address workplace risks, prevent accidents and provide readily accessible health and safety resources and information to all staff.
Promote safe work practices and proactive risk identification.
Working Conditions: Ensure all workplaces meet statutory requirements related to cleanliness, ventilation, lighting, and welfare facilities.
Promote respectful supervision and ethical management practices at all levels of the organization.
Social Dialogue: To maintain an open and transparent communication culture between management and employees, ensuring regular feedback mechanisms and proactive resolution of workplace concerns.
Career Development & Training: To conduct annual performance reviews to support career advancement and encourage internal mobility by promoting from within when possible.
Align training programs with technological advancements, and regulatory requirements.
Child Labor, Forced Labor & Human Traffi: Maintain zero-tolerance policies on child and forced labor throughout operations.
Conduct background checks on suppliers to ensure compliance with labor standards.
Protect fundamental human rights in all business activities.
Non-Discrimination & Harassment: Promote equal opportunity and an inclusive workplace free from discrimination or harassment.
Strengthen and continuously improve grievance redressal mechanisms to ensure fair, timely, and transparent resolution of concerns.
External Stakeholder Human Rights: Respect human rights across suppliers, partners, and communities.
Encourage ethical practices throughout the supply chain.
Maintain open communication and grievance mechanisms to address stakeholder concerns transparently and build trust.
Fair Wages & Benefits: Ensure wages and benefits are fair, competitive, and legally compliant.
Periodically review compensation structures to support employee welfare.
Work-Life Balance: Promote supportive policies that help employees balance professional and personal responsibilities.
Ensure workloads are properly managed to maintain productivity and employee well-being.

targets.target: Increase workplace safety inspections by 25% by 2030 to proactively identify risks.
Reduce absenteeism due to work-related injuries by 50% by 2030.
Achieve a 95% positive response rate in annual employee satisfaction surveys by 2030.
Provide statutory healthcare and insurance benefits to 100% eligible employees by year 2030.
Achieve 90% attendance in labor-management meetings by year 2030.
Achieve 100% participation in employee feedback activities by year 2030.
Conduct annual performance reviews and maintain documented development plans for 100% eligible employees.
Increase internal promotions by 25% by 2030.
Allocate 5% of annual budget to employee development and career programs by 2030.

responsibilities.duty: The Human Resources (HR) Manager will be responsible for compiling and preparing the annual labor and human rights performance report.
Oversees policy implementation, employee training, and compliance with labor standards.
Ensures safe working conditions, monitors employee health and safety, and implements career development programs.
Drives diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives and monitors progress.
Audits suppliers and enforces policies on child and forced labor prevention.
Reviews progress, allocates resources, and provides strategic direction for human rights and labor practices.

policy.monitoring: Bhabani Colors Pvt. Ltd. undertakes continuous monitoring of its labor standards and human rights performance across key areas such as employee health and safety, working conditions, social dialogue, learning and career development, prevention of child and forced labor, non-discrimination and harassment, and the protection of external stakeholder human rights. The Company tracks defined Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) through established internal monitoring mechanisms, with quarterly reviews and consolidated reporting to senior management to support informed decision-making. Annual evaluations assess overall progress, identify improvement areas, and drive corrective actions, while appropriate disclosures are made to stakeholders to enhance transparency and accountability. All monitoring and reporting processes are aligned with applicable labor regulations, international human rights principles, and industry best practices to ensure accuracy, reliability, and credibility.
policy.reviewMechanism: The HR Manager, will conduct annual review of this policy to assess policy effectiveness, monitor compliance, and adjust targets as needed. The review process includes analyzing quarterly reports, gathering employee feedback, and benchmarking against industry standards. Findings are reported to CEO, and policy adjustments are made to ensure continuous improvement in labor and human rights practices at Bhabani Colors Pvt. Ltd.
